title: SDG 1 消除貧窮
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #1 No Poverty 消除貧窮

strip.en: the first of the 17 Global Goals
the year the world wants to end extreme poverty
strip.zh: 年，全世界希望消除極端貧窮

strip.en: the year your school was born

lines.en: I have been teaching students in Taiwan for a couple of years.
lines.zh: 我在台灣教學生已經有幾年了。
今天的主題：SDG 1 消除貧窮。

slides.ask_en: Think: what do you need every day to live well?
slides.ask_zh: 想一想：每天要過得好，你需要哪些東西？

slides.ask_en: California is rich — but some families there still cannot pay for a home. Poverty can happen anywhere.
slides.ask_zh: 加州很富有，但還是有些家庭付不起房租。貧窮在哪裡都可能發生。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever saved money for something you wanted.
prompts.zh: 曾經為了想要的東西存錢的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you have ever given something to a person who needed it.
prompts.zh: 曾經把東西送給需要的人的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stand up if you know the difference between a need and a want.
prompts.zh: 知道「需要」和「想要」差在哪裡的，站起來。

slides.punch_en: Today we learn about people who do not have enough — and how we can help.
slides.punch_zh: 今天我們要認識那些擁有得不夠的人——還有我們可以怎麼幫忙。

slides.body_en: In 2015, every country agreed on 17 Global Goals for 2030. Goal 1 is No Poverty: no one should live without food, clean water, a safe home, school or a doctor because they do not have enough money.
slides.body_zh: 2015 年，全世界所有國家訂下 17 項全球目標，要在 2030 年前達成。第 1 項是「消除貧窮」：不該有人因為沒有錢，就沒有食物、乾淨的水、安全的家、學校或醫生。

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for NEED, thumbs down for WANT!

slides.head_en: If the world were a class of 30…
slides.head_zh: 如果全世界縮成一個 30 人的班…
slides.reveal_en: About 3 would live on less than US$3 a day.
slides.reveal_zh: 大約有 3 個人，一天的生活費不到 3 美元。

slides.head_en: a day — for food, water, a home and everything else
slides.head_zh: 一天——要用來買食物、水、付房租，和其他所有東西
slides.body_en: That is about NT$100. About 1 in 10 people on Earth live on less than this.
slides.body_zh: 大約是新台幣 100 元。全世界大約每 10 個人就有 1 個，一天的生活費比這還少。
slides.ask_en: What do you spend NT$100 on?
slides.ask_zh: 你的 100 元會花在什麼上面？

slides.q_en: Which one can help a child out of poverty for the LONGEST time?
slides.q_zh: 下列哪一個，最能長久幫助一個孩子脫離貧窮？
slides.explain_en: Going to school. What you learn stays with you for life — that is why SDG 1 and SDG 4 go together.
slides.explain_zh: 去上學。學到的東西會跟著你一輩子——所以 SDG 1 和 SDG 4（優質教育）是一起的。

slides.head_en: Lukang Has Been Rich — and Poor
slides.body_en: About 200 years ago, Lukang was one of Taiwan's busiest ports. Then sand filled the harbor, the big ships stopped coming, and many families lost their work. Today crafts, food and visitors bring the town to life again.
slides.body_zh: 大約兩百年前，鹿港是台灣最熱鬧的港口之一。後來港口被泥沙淤積，大船不再來，很多家庭失去了工作。現在，工藝、美食和遊客又讓小鎮熱鬧起來。

slides.q_en: Muhammad Yunus won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2006. What did his bank do?
slides.q_zh: 尤努斯在 2006 年得到諾貝爾和平獎。他的銀行做了什麼？

options.en: Lent small amounts of money to poor people

slides.explain_en: Small loans — often to women — to start tiny businesses, like selling eggs or making baskets.
slides.explain_zh: 小額貸款——常常借給女性——讓她們開小生意，像是賣雞蛋或編籃子。

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Poverty only happens in poor countries.
items.zh: 貧窮只會發生在窮的國家。
items.note_en: It happens in every country — including Taiwan and the USA.
items.note_zh: 每個國家都有，包括台灣和美國。

items.en: Being poor is always a person's own fault.
items.note_en: Illness, disasters, losing a job — many reasons are no one's fault.
items.note_zh: 生病、天災、失業——很多原因都不是誰的錯。

items.en: Going to school can help children escape poverty.
items.zh: 上學可以幫助孩子脫離貧窮。
items.note_en: Education opens doors to better jobs.
items.note_zh: 教育能打開通往更好工作的門。

items.en: Kids can help fight poverty, too.
items.zh: 小孩也可以幫忙對抗貧窮。
items.note_en: Share, give, and treat everyone with respect.
items.note_zh: 分享、捐出、尊重每一個人。

items.zh: 每個人都應該擁有足夠的。

items.en: Is it a need or a want?
I can share what I have.

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many things a family NEEDS as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「一個家需要的東西」越好，我來數！
slides.target_zh: 要打破的班級紀錄：15 個

slides.prompt_en: If you had NT$100 to help someone, what would you do with it?
slides.prompt_zh: 如果你有 100 元可以幫助別人，你會怎麼用？
slides.sentence_en: I would use it to ______ because ______.
slides.time_en: 60 seconds — then 3 pairs share with the class.
slides.time_zh: 60 秒，然後請 3 組跟全班分享。

slides.sub_en: Vote with your hands — 1, 2, 3, or 4 fingers.

items.en: Give away clothes you have outgrown
Treat everyone with respect, rich or poor

slides.reveal_en: All four help. #3 costs nothing — and anyone can do it today.
slides.reveal_zh: 四個都有幫助。第 3 個不用花錢——而且今天就做得到。

slides.note_en: Watch — then tell me one way YOU can help.
slides.note_zh: 看完之後，告訴我一個「你」可以幫忙的方法。

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Before you buy something, ask: need or want?
items.zh: 買東西之前先問：需要，還是想要？

items.en: Give what you have outgrown to someone who can use it.
items.zh: 把用不到的東西，送給用得到的人。

items.en: Never laugh at someone for what they do not have.
items.zh: 絕不嘲笑別人沒有的東西。

slides.q_en: The United Nations has a special day to end poverty. When is it?
slides.q_zh: 聯合國有一個「消除貧窮」的國際日。是哪一天？
slides.explain_en: October 17 — the International Day for the Eradication of Poverty.
slides.explain_zh: 10 月 17 日——國際消除貧窮日。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Lukang Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — just write your comment for Teacher Dom.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到鹿港國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，直接留言跟 Teacher Dom 互動。

slides.big_zh: 每個人，都應該擁有足夠的。
